title: Privacy: a cloud erase whose session changed during the engine call, or that came back with no view, never reaches showErased: the store does not count it, and it keeps the record it held before the erase
evidence: US-25 AC16g: CloudSync.erase hands every erase the engine finished to RecordStore.showErased, whatever the connection did during the await; eraseEnded already ignores a session no longer shown. showErased reads stillShown (CloudSync still shows the session) in its step: then it draws as before; otherwise drawErased (RecordStore+Source.swift) lands it only on that session's record and keeps any other record shown (a newer session's or the phone's) marked as predating the erase (AC21), and counts it either way. No view: counted and marked the same way. Tests: CloudConnectionPinsTests testAnEraseWhoseSessionClosedMeanwhileStillReachesTheStore_US25_AC16g (a Disconnect during the erase; not counted on main), EraseHeldUndrawnTests three AC16g. Was: ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/CloudSync.swift:198 (main 55d6fde5). From the adversary reviews of PR 1599 (F6, re-check F3)
